title: Soul Factory Concord onboarding via CORD-05 Direct Invite
observed_behavior_before: Soul Factory could assign newly provisioned identities to NIP-29 groups and Communikeys communities after Signet provisioning.
Bahia had no Concord configuration, CORD-05 invite builder, or Signet-backed NIP-44 encryption surface.
Provisioning runs did not record Concord community onboarding.
intended_behavior: Configuration identifies optional Concord communities by self-certifying community_id and references invite bundle JSON through an environment variable or absolute secret file rather than inline key material.

After Signet provisions an agent identity, Soul Factory validates the CORD-05 CommunityInvite and sends a standard NIP-59 Direct Invite: kind-3313 rumor, staff-signed kind-13 seal, and ephemeral kind-1059 wrap tagged p=<recipient> and k=3313.
The Signet-held Soul Factory staff key performs recipient NIP-44 encryption and seal signing without exposing its private key to Bahia.
Relay authentication and publish acceptance are required; configuration, cryptography, or relay failures fail the Signet provisioning step closed.
Successful onboarding records only configured Concord community identifiers, never invite key material.
